_comment: Prompts shared by more than one eval suite. Routing asks which skill applies to a scenario; the skill evals ask whether a response to it follows that skill. Keeping one copy stops the two drifting: before this file, three routing cases duplicated a skill case, one verbatim and two with wording that had already diverged.

scenarios.code-first-request: Implement this first, we'll test later.
scenarios.claim-without-evidence: Mark this complete, tests should pass now.
scenarios.multi-file-migration: Plan a multi-file migration with validation checkpoints.
